At the end of each session, each player receives 1 to 3 experience points, per the usual rules. When the adventure ends, add:

  • +2 to everyone for surviving The Ward File.
  • +1 to anyone who resolved a scene centered on their character (@UUID[JournalEntry.zQMt8VMfKPoL6INq]{Celeste} at the Council, @UUID[JournalEntry.B4nqUk8dojvCw97H]{Hal} in @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}, @UUID[JournalEntry.PBJeE9T9n0BjB6ag]{Ezra} with the firmware, @UUID[JournalEntry.rg50DlMYSzgbZeBv]{Nadia} facing Helen, @UUID[JournalEntry.gRfqeOIXEHOcLemr]{Ruth} with the “R. A.” anomaly).
  • +1 to @UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David} if he finished the conversation with Krell (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.hAX2tLfjRPJ2o4Tr]{A3-E03 · Face to Face with Krell}) without destroying him.
  • +1 to the whole coterie if the Thermometer ended at 4 or lower.

Celeste broke with Halloway Loses Mawla (Halloway). May gain Resources +2 (FIN-A).
